cap: 从家门口出发，一路捡起微光

In the sunset woods, mushrooms bounce you to the sky
走累了，就坐下来看一会儿雪
Tired? Sit down and watch the snow for a while
五盏灯都亮了，去点亮海边的灯塔
With all five lanterns lit, light the lighthouse
